name: meetings-stay-free
description: With the meetings and tickets in the prompt and no destination, the plan is printed and no ticket block sits on a meeting.
prompt:
Plan my week. Today is Monday 2026-11-02 at 09:00. No weekly-planning.destination is set; there is no calendar tool and no tracker. Work hours 09:00-18:00, every day Monday to Friday is a work day.
Meetings: Monday 10:00-11:00 Standup, Tuesday 14:00-16:00 Planning.
Tickets: ABC-1 Fix login timeout (8h), ABC-2 Add audit log (4h).
Do not run any tool and do not save anywhere: do what the skill says to do when there is nowhere to save, and do the fitting yourself following the script's rules.

assertions.description: no ticket on top of a meeting
